question: What physical rejuvenation and freedom from disease result from this visualization?
premises: The practitioner becomes freed from wrinkles and grey hair.
The practitioner becomes devoid of all diseases.
These are effects of the described meditation.
inference: This meditation renders the practitioner free from wrinkles, grey hair, and all diseases.
uncertainties: The accusative ending of sarvavyādhivivarjitam may agree with an implied object rather than the nominative subject.
plain_english: One becomes freed from wrinkles and grey hair, and devoid of all diseases.
